observations: Seller provided only text claiming testing; no new images/videos were shared.
Photos still show stacked blue plastic drums with metal-hardware lids; surface wear/staining is visible.
No readable capacity marking or certification/food-grade stamp is visible in the provided photos.

identity.kind: plastic storage drums (food-grade water storage type)

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: No chemical compatibility/specification is shown in photos; seller text alone is not proof.
No food-grade certification stamp/label is readable in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water.
claims.evidence: Photos show prior-use wear/staining; cannot confirm single-use history.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: Seller claims testing, but no new video/photo of the test or close-up of seals/leak points was provided.

risks.risk: Leakage or micro-cracks not visible in photos (especially around lid seals and seams).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of one selected drum filled with water (to near top), showing no seepage around lid and bottom seam over a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used drums with unknown leak status (worst case: may require gasket/lid replacement or reject for leaks).

risks.risk: Not actually food-grade / wrong plastic grade or missing liner.
risks.proof: Request clear close-up photos of any stamp/label (food-grade/NSF/WRAS) and the drum material code; ideally a spec sheet/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-certified used plastic drums (food-grade not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Capacity/size unknown; price depends on liters.
risks.proof: Request a photo showing the capacity marking (liters) or a measuring-tape shot (height and diameter).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely capacity tier for storage drums until confirmed.

risks.risk: Lid gasket/seal condition may vary across drums.
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of lid gasket/rim on 2–3 different drums (including one from the front and one from the back/side).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming seals may need replacement/adjustment.

proof_requests: Send new proof video: fill one drum with water and show lid + bottom seam for leaks (no seepage).
Send close-up photos of any capacity marking (liters) on the drum body.
Send close-up photos of any food-grade/certification stamp/label and drum material code.
Send close-ups of lid seals/gaskets on at least 2–3 drums.
response.reason: The seller’s text repeats the same claims, but without new photos/videos the key pricing drivers (capacity, food-grade proof, and leak test evidence) remain unverifiable remotely.
